memory: Confirmed: fast adsorption at 60% RH (τ_fast ≈95 s, A≈0.11 pF) plus slow term (~24 min, A≈0.09 pF). Single‑shot 10 s captures required. D2O exposure lengthened τ_fast to 140 ±11 s and reduced A_fast slightly; slow term unchanged. Effect reversible after H2O reintroduction. Controls (N2 flush, trigger checks) intact. Raw traces and fits archived. Current position: isotope sensitivity pins the fast carrier to processes that involve hydrogen motion or H‑bond reorganization rather than only bulk vapor transport.
openQuestion: Measure τ_fast(T) for H2O and D2O at 10, 15, 20, 25°C to extract activation energies and compare isotope effects.
